name: Microgrid storage grid-forming availability input
summary: Receives the storage system's declared capability to establish the assigned AC reference.
description: Receives the storage system's declared capability to establish the assigned AC reference. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Storage operating capability” at the input and “Grid-forming availability” at the output. Not every converter operating state supports grid forming.
